textures.uncertainty: Original1200×1200 photograph; four source mounting centers align the PCB plane. Remaining lens/perspective and component-height error is not a claim of exact PCB CAD.
textures.mapping: Four mounting-hole centers from v1.1 top photo rectify to source PCB coordinates; texture restricted to actual source top faces atZ5.752. Raised module, sockets, button and fasteners excluded.
textures.method: Four explicit original-image film corners rectified by OpenCV getPerspectiveTransform/warpPerspective (Lanczos4); original-coordinate alpha ROI and hardware exclusions applied before warp. Original pixels only; projection uncertainty recorded, not independent geometry verification.

textures.uncertainty: Original1200×1200 photograph; four source mounting centers align the PCB plane. Remaining lens/perspective and component-height error is not a claim of exact PCB CAD.
textures.mapping: Back-camera X mirrored explicitly in source quadrilateral, matching renderer back projection. Only broad source underside planeZ4.252 receives PCB photo; raised optical module, wires, connectors and frame crossmembers excluded.
textures.method: Four explicit original-image film corners rectified by OpenCV getPerspectiveTransform/warpPerspective (Lanczos4); original-coordinate alpha ROI and hardware exclusions applied before warp. Original pixels only; projection uncertainty recorded, not independent geometry verification.

textures.mapping: Separate paper17.6×23.2mm lies wholly within exact18×24mm S3A cover. Only v1.1 label pixels; transparent inset preserves orange rim. Cover holes/embossing cannot clip the paper.
textures.method: Fixed axis-aligned crop; original-coordinate explicit alpha ROI at4x supersampling when alphaMask supplied; exclusions remove fasteners/holes/shell. No generated pixels or perspective warp.

textures.mapping: Back-facing independent13.2×23.2mm optical-flow PCB face; photo pixelleft is model+X, matching backUVflip. True photosurface stays inside estimated board. Hidden face markedUNKNOWN.
textures.uncertainty: Scale estimated from samephoto mounting-hole spacing; board position/depth are photo/source-envelope estimates, not a v1.1 PCB assemblyCAD.
textures.method: Fixed axis-aligned crop; original-coordinate explicit alpha ROI at4x supersampling when alphaMask supplied; exclusions remove fasteners/holes/shell. No generated pixels or perspective warp.

tessellation.step: OpenCascade 7.8.1.1; absolute deflection0.05mm, angle0.2rad, native solids plus orphan shells/faces; units converted by STEP reader to millimetres

sources.notes: Receipt covers actual retrieved bytes. Raw full documents/API responses and firmware remain temporary; only selected reference images are retained.

limitations: Shared frame, carrier, motors and adapter are an official-linked Ecosystem v1 simulator assembly, not a complete manufacturer v1.1 CAD release. Common-frame identity is supported by photos/dimension relationships but not a v1.1 CAD version tag.

Source frame81.842mm preserved atscale1. Official73.6mm field does not span outer guards; dimension drawing65mm diagonal motor spacing plus36.2mm guard impliesabout82.2mm. This scope conflict remains open.
Exact S3A cover replaces older S3. Seating height remains a source/photo estimate; no hidden S3A PCB components are invented.
No installed battery is shown, matching selected official photos. The source older battery is not relabelled as the v1.1 320mAh pack; variant pack dimensions remain unverified.
Visible PCB photography restores exterior appearance only. Black PCB remains black under shell presets; UNKNOWN on underside identifies hidden layout uncertainty.

Hex-socket screw recesses, grommet cross-sections, connector mouths and four-blade profiles are photo estimates. Hidden screw shafts, standoffs, threads, propeller pitch and connector contact fit are unverified.
Paper label is an independent bounded surface inside the exact cover. Camera lighting is not a calibrated material color.
Visual assets establish no firmware execution, RPM calibration, flight dynamics or physical hardware validation.
